## Ruled · 2026-11-17T03:41Z

The maintainer, in the os-support-ai fleet project (thread "Run objectstack seat 3 console experience") at 2026-11-17T03:40Z, answered the seat's four-question pack (reviewed first by an independent fable agent at his request) with one word, verbatim: 「同意」 — i.e. every recommendation below.

Ruled: A — org menu items follow the served deployment signals (`features.cloudManaged`, `features.tenancyPosture`, `multiOrgEnabled` from `GET /auth/config`); **no Setup override key** (item 5 is dropped; this supersedes the maintainer's earlier 「这些应该在设置中都可以配置」); **no new menu extension point** (item 4): the cloud layer adds its items through the existing `manifest.navigationContributions` path (`setup-nav.contributions.ts`). Single-org member management stays reachable at Setup → Organization (ruling 6384629949 on #25347). Item 3 (moving `WorkspaceSwitcher` into the avatar menu) is checked against ADR-0105 before building; a conflict comes back to the maintainer.
Prior rulings: 6341690661 (#25083), 6384629949 (#25347).

## Claim amendment · 2026-11-17T07:13Z

Amends claim 6937604379 (area o3-D, same session, same branch `claude/issue-34591-org-menu-posture`). The **File surface** adds `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/CurrentOrganizationIndicator.tsx` and its tests (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/CurrentOrganizationIndicator*.test.tsx`).

Seat ruling (repo:objectstack#3 seat, decided under an existing rule, not a maintainer question): moving the switcher into the avatar menu must not leave a walled-posture member of 2+ organizations without the active organization's name on screen (objectui#5287: a scoped list says which organization it is scoped to). So `CurrentOrganizationIndicator` names the active organization **read-only** at any membership count on walled postures, where it renders today (not the top-left app-switcher slot); a read-only name is not a switcher, so 「左上角应该是切换应用的」 still holds. Done inside this card so PR #34697 lands no regression. Everything else in 6937604379 stands.
